headline: US CFTC Approves Event Contract Data Rules and Crypto Compliance Guidance
summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission issued a data reporting rule for event contracts and introduced new guidance detailing how crypto assets can be used to meet regulatory requirements.
why: The CFTC regulates U.S. derivatives markets, and its rules define operational standards for emerging prediction contracts and institutional cryptocurrency usage.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency Sector
impacts.why: CFTC guidance sets official terms under which market participants can use crypto assets for compliance obligations.
